## Problem and change

Describe the user or contributor problem, the resulting behavior, and the affected skills or tools.
Link the relevant issue or proposal when available.

## Verification

Record focused and affected checks, commands, results, and remaining gaps.
For skill, related test, or authoring/build-script changes, include final `npm run verify` evidence.
Distinguish deterministic checks, model-backed behavior or trigger evaluations, and real host activation when relevant.
Model calls require separate explicit execution authorization.
